public_source.title: Order 29, Hadamard maximal determinant problem
public_source.evidence: Lists a conjectured D-optimal Gram matrix due to Bruce Solomon and gives its determinant as (320*7^12*2^28)^2; the corresponding sign-matrix determinant magnitude is 320*7^12*2^28.
public_source.supporting_witness_title: New lower bounds for the maximal determinant problem

limitations: This is the published best-known feasible value in the cited sources, not a proof of global optimality.
The source documents a conjectured Gram matrix and a lower-bound construction; the maximal determinant at order 29 remains uncertified.
